profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @LinkedIn | Frontend | Full Stack | React/Typescript ♡ | Foodie | Father | World Traveler
profile.summary:
Working on messaging at LinkedIn. 📨

I derive deep gratification from the design and creation of aesthetically pleasing, efficient systems.

I am a software engineer based near San Francisco, well-versed in a myriad of frontend and backend languages and frameworks. 

I keep current with the latest technologies. In my recent projects, I have been building with React/Next/Typescript on the frontend, and Java or Node REST APIs on the server side. On the database side, I have experience with GraphQL, MongoDB, MySQL, MSSQL, CockroachDB, and PostgreSQL. 

When I approach a new problem, I break it down into its component parts, consider multiple available options, forge an actionable path, and then work iteratively towards a solution. 

I value openness, robust collaboration, and precision in communication. I take pride in elegant, clean, concise, and modular code. I thrive in an environment that respects autonomy, wellness, learning, growth and creativity.

Before LinkedIn, I was the UI tech lead on an internal observability dashboard for The Hut Group’s B2B Team, building a paginated, searchable, filterable, and sortable UI and enabling users to rapidly find and fix errors in the order flow. I implemented frontend caching, as well as building & deploying a backend microservice and database schema handling granular authorization control. After deployment (using VMs, Docker, Jenkins) the tool resulted in a 80% increase in efficiency over the old workflow.

More about me:
Fluent in Spanish. Conversational in Portuguese. Once took a course in bird language. Have traveled to 30 countries. Was a Peace Corps volunteer in the Dominican Republic. Started an organic rare subtropical fruit farm. Hobbies: photography, soccer, meditation, exploring hidden beaches and hot springs, being an Airbnb host, and spending time with my seven year old daughter.

Site: 
https://www.ericbroberg.me

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created from scratch a dashboard-style UI, allowing supply chain team members to work with EDI orders, increasing accuracy, reducing time spent investigating and fixing errors.

Added features to other internal React and Angular UIs facilitating the management of B2B orders, increasing the efficiency and easing the workflow of business users.

Interfaced with finance and supply chain teams to define requirements, learn user stories, and custom design frontend and backend flows to meet needs of users.

Built authentication system for above mentioned UIs, using Keycloak.

Increased security by resolving critical vulnerabilities (we had 20+, reduced to 0), using Snyk.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Docker Products · React · Angular · JavaScript · Java · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed pixel perfect online store features using JavaScript (React), HTML and CSS leading to increased engagement and personalization for customers.

Led the technical integration of essential third-party warehouse systems to our retail ecommerce platforms, leading to increases in efficiency and cost-savings.

Connected online store to third-party email system, facilitating seamless communication about orders and shipments to customers, easing the workflow and saving money for the business.

Migrated ecommerce store from Demandware to Shopify, leading to cost-savings and decreased technical debt.

Implemented PayPal functionality, allowing customers to make instant purchases - reducing steps to purchase from four to one.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description:
For small, growing startup: built Angular components for the new mobile-first web app, improving user experience with validation and autocomplete on form fields, among many other features.

Developed new API endpoints with PHP and increased end-to-end test coverage to 100%.
positions.insights: Skills: Test-Driven Development · SQL · HTML5 · Angular · Git · Microsoft SQL Server · PHP · JavaScript · End-to-end Testing · TypeScript · CSS · jQuery · Microsoft Azure · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built a web application to streamline management of international orders with thousands of products, delivering a 30% increase in efficiency and accuracy to the process.

Constructed an accessible, paginated, searchable user interface using React, Redux and Bootstrap.

Built REST API endpoints with JavaScript to handle backend of app, integrating it with ERP system.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Bootstrap · Webpack · Gulp.js · Redux.js · JavaScript · ES6 · CSS · React.js · HTML · GruntJS

positions.title: Owner, Operator, and Farmer
positions.description:
Edulis Gardens is my land-based, organic, low-tech startup. We organically grow passionfruit, other rare fruit, and avocados on a piece of sandy, eucalyptus-filled land on the mesa in Arroyo Grande. At this point other folks manage day-to-day operations; I manage sales and social media, and get my hands dirty when I visit the farm.

I designed, planned, and bootstrapped this small organic farm from the ground up. I crafted a niche market for unique, rare fruit among LA chefs, SF distributors, and local farm stands. 

I also built responsive business website, including online store, with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 3 and jQuery.

positions.title: Greywater Systems Installer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description: For some years, in various locations, and when asked, I have been installing greywater systems, primarily the Laundry to Landscape standard that properly and safely distributes guilt-free water to landscape, fruit trees, and greenery. #droughthack

positions.title: Peace Corps Volunteer
positions.description:
Fully designed and coordinated a project (construction of 100 healthier, more efficient cookstoves) involving solicitation and management of $18,000 in federal, NGO and community funds. Directed two skilled masons and alongside them learned cement block masonry and many other construction skills.

Initiated an organic school garden, incorporating sustainability and cooking education. Solicited and managed grant funds ($1,200) to support the school garden project and local home garden creation.

Taught sustainable agriculture courses to high school students.

Organized an led meetings with local cacao growers and agronomists, incorporating sustainable farming practices

projects.title: Buy Request UI
projects.description:
Videos:
http://recordit.co/8CThuYTMEF
http://recordit.co/wy8T30dbDG

A custom user interface built for WSI to facilitate reviewing and updating large franchise transactions. The frontend is React, Redux, ES6, Webpack and Bootstrap. I constructed the backend with SuiteScript suitelets.

The UI is plugged into NetSuite and allows purchasers to easily interact with large records. Thousands of lines load quickly and are displayed as a paginated, searchable table with dynamic filtering on certain columns.

projects.description: My responsive business website built with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 3 and jQuery, including an online store for the specialty rare fruit that I grow.
